verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own pages document M&A experience with venture-backed tech companies: about $650B in transactions, including the WhatsApp sale to Facebook and Figma's proposed acquisition by Adobe. The Startup Resource Center covers stages through 'preparing for exit', and equity-comp work touches 280G and pre-public company RSUs. The public-offering half of the story is essentially unevidenced. Missing for 10: a dedicated IPO/capital-markets practice page or documented public-offering track record, a dedicated M&A practice page (deals are cited only on the technology transactions page), and independent corroboration.
